text: 中国财政部发行28天期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率0.7826%，边际利率0.9784%，预期0.8700%，投标倍数3.80倍，边际倍数1.07倍； 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模300亿元，发行利率1.0415%，边际利率1.1585%，预期1.0000%，投标倍数3.24倍，边际倍数19.76倍； 中国财政部发行30年期债券，规模730亿元，发行利率2.1849%，预期2.1800%，投标倍数6.56倍，边际倍数2.42倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 28-day bonds totaling RMB 20 billion at an issuance rate of 0.7826%, marginal rate of 0.9784%, expected 0.8700%, bid-to-cover ratio of 3.80 times, and marginal ratio of 1.07 times; issued 91-day bonds totaling RMB 30 billion at 1.0415%, marginal rate of 1.1585%, expected 1.0000%, bid-to-cover ratio of 3.24 times, and marginal ratio of 19.76 times; issued 30-year bonds totaling RMB 73 billion at 2.1849%, expected 2.1800%, bid-to-cover ratio of 6.56 times, and marginal ratio of 2.42 times.
